data.name: Faiyaj
data.gender_notes: Faiyaj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Faiyaj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Vajra', which means 'thunderbolt'. In Hindu mythology, Indra, the god of rain and thunder, wielded a vajra, or thunderbolt. Faiyaj can be considered the name of a god or a warrior who conquers the gods with his power. The name Faiyaj carries the meaning “Conqueror of gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Faiyaj usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringer of divine power and strength
data.etymology: Faiyaj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror of gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faiyaj total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
